blocks.text:
After that another person came forward to pledge allegiance and, taking hold of his hands, asked, “O Rasulullah! What will he get who believed in you without seeing you, affirmed your truth and followed you?” The Prophet ﷺ replied, “For him there is great good fortune. And (further) for him there is great good fortune. And (further still) for him there is great good fortune.’ He too stroked the blessed hands of the Prophet (for barakah) and (after making bai'ah) went away.
(Ahmad)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسي ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: ثَلَاثَةٌ لَهُمْ أَجْرَانِ: رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ آمَنَ بِنَبِيِّهِ وَآمَنَ بِمُحَمَّد ﷺ، وَالْعَبْدُ الْمَمْلُوكُ إِذَا أَدَّي حَقَّ اللهِ تَعَالَي وَحَقَّ مَوَالِيهِ، وَرَجُلٌ كَانَتْ عِنْدَهُ أَمَةٌ فَأَدَّبَهَا فَأَحْسَنَ تَأْدِيبَهَا وَعَلَّمَهَا فَأَحْسَنَ تَعْلِيمَهَا ثُمَّ أَعْتَقَهَا فَتَزَوَّجَهَا فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب تعليم الرجل امته واهله، رقم:٩٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Musa (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Three people will receive a double reward: (The first) one of the People of the Book (a Christian or a Jew) who believed in his earlier Prophet and then also believed in Muhammad ﷺ. (The second) a slave who fulfils the duties owed to Allah and also fulfils the duties owed to his master. (The third) one who taught good manners in a good way to a slave-girl he owned, taught her (religious) knowledge in a good way, then freed her and married her himself. (These three will receive a double reward).”

blocks.text: Explanation:- For every good deed these people do, compared to what is given to others,
